messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch backlog spike. Saw 3 customer P0s overnight and a few polish asks. Can we decide what goes into Sprint N+1?
chris: which P0s?
maya: 1) hard crash on long prompts (seems regressed after runtime tweak) — 8 reports, 2 repros. 2) embeddings mismatch for recent commit (affects search rank for one large customer). 3) UI microcopy + copy overflow in model chooser.
oliver: crash is P0 from Acme — they're blocked on an integration test. embeddings is high impact for Beta partner but can be mitigated with workaround. UI is low revenue.
sasha: if we're swapping scope, can we land a superficial UI fix now and do a fuller polish later? e.g., clamp text, wrap, and add tooltip. 2 engineer-days max.
chris: crash needs dedicated attention — I can look but will need Lee on infra cause stack traces point at KV cache eviction timing. @lee can you spare a day?
lee: I can carve out a full day tomorrow AM. we should also roll back the runtime tweak in canary to verify. deploy-bot: canary rollback scheduled by @chris at 2025-06-18T09:20Z.
maya: good — priority order proposal: 1) crash, 2) embeddings regression, 3) UI microcopy. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
chris: agree. embeddings might be a quick bisect but could be model-change induced. need product repro prompts. @maya can you attach failing prompt set?
maya: adding snippet below — cc @oliver for customer repros:
```
user: "Find related documents about refund policy for enterprise accounts"
system: "embedding request v2"
```
oliver: shared a customer repro bundle to the shared drive (link) and marked it P1 for the Beta partner.
sasha: for UI, I'll drop a tiny patch with wrap + tooltip and a screenshot for approval, wants design review though.
chris: plan: tomorrow morning Lee + I triage crash, attempt quick rollback in canary; if we confirm rollback fixes, we schedule hotfix patch for canary -> prod. embeddings: I'll start bisecting after crash Triage, might take 1-2 days. UI: ship quick patch as part of routine sprint.
maya: acceptance criteria for crash fix: reproducible case fails pre-fix and succeeds post-fix; perf impact <= 5% p50. For embeddings: we need a precise diff and a fallback plan (retrain vs rollback).
lee: logging change request: add trace id to KV eviction logs: `evict_kv(key, reason, trace_id)` — will push a small agent log patch.
chris: tagging: `triage/urgent`, `customer/p0`, `area/runtime`. I'll create the tickets.
maya: schedule check-in: 2025-06-18 16:00 PT to confirm roll forward/rollback decision. ping everyone then.
oliver: will notify Acme and Beta partner with status and ETA.
sasha: :thumbsup: short UX patch ready later today.
chris: if we need to swap scope out of Sprint N+1, propose we defer the lower-priority roadmap item (feature: advanced reranking) by one sprint to free cycles.
maya: agreed — I will slack the feature owner and update the roadmap doc. thanks all.
deploy-bot: production deploy successful at 2025-06-17T23:02Z (sha: b7e2c9).
